build_SemanticMCPToolFilter: build a SemanticMCPToolFilter instance with embedding model and litellm router for semantic tool filtering
build_router_from_mcp_registry: build the semantic router from all MCP tools in the global registry without auth checks
filter_tools: filter tools semantically based on a user query using the built semantic router
extract_user_query: extract the user query string from chat completion or response message dictionaries
build_router: build a semantic router with a list of MCPTool objects or OpenAI function dicts as routes
